fieldName.description: The actual fieldName of what's being filtered

displayName.description: The displayed name of what's being filtered

valueType.description:
The different valueTypes of the field we are filtering on

datetime - will have a {@link UiSdlDateTimeInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a datetime filter

number - will have a {@link UiSdlTextInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a number filter

string - will have a {@link UiSdlTextInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a string filter

category - will have a {@link UiSdlSelectInputFormDataGrid} cell to apply a categorical filter
